runtime.rankingExplain: ability page explains normalized query, query guards, ranking weights, exact phrase score, term coverage score, CJK bigram score, freshness score and top result scores
runtime.rankingExplainUi: ability page renders search ranking explanation as guard, weight, and top-result score tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.probeResultUi: ability page renders search probe results as bounded score breakdown tables instead of only raw JSON
runtime.rebuildResultUi: ability page renders search.rebuild execution result as a bounded offset/limit operation table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.rebuildBackgroundTask: search.rebuild writes a completed content.search.rebuild row into content_background_task with bounded offset/limit payload and result metadata
runtime.rebuildTaskUi: ability page shows backgroundTaskId and queued state for each bounded search index rebuild batch
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders search.stats as an index health table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.categoryFilter: when content.category is enabled, search.query accepts categoryId and applies a bounded EXISTS filter on content_category_bind; normal searches keep the existing SQL path
runtime.cjkLooseLike: continuous CJK query characters insert bounded LIKE wildcards between adjacent ideographs to improve Chinese recall without changing SQL shape
runtime.exactPhraseScore: normalized full query phrase adds a bounded in-memory score inside the already matched candidate set; title phrase hits receive double weight
runtime.cjkBigramScore: continuous CJK query characters are scored by adjacent two-character coverage in indexed title/keywords/summary/body without adding a tokenizer service
runtime.termCoverage: normalized query terms add bounded per-term score across title, keywords, summary and body
runtime.freshnessScore: recently updated content receives a bounded configurable score within freshnessWindowDays
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: search result rows and rebuild candidate objects prefer content_category_bind when content.category is enabled, with legacy content_item.category_id only as a compatibility mirror
runtime.accessIntegration: public search results and count filter restricted content when content.access is enabled
